session.defaultInstruction: No extra instructions; follow the selected skill.

im.visionUnsupported: The current model “{model}” can’t read images, so I can’t see this one (the text is handled as usual). Switch the default model to a vision model in Settings (such as qwen3-vl-plus). If it does support images, turn on Vision for it under Additional models in the provider settings and send the image again.
im.tooManyImages: Up to {max} images are handled at a time; only the first {max} are used this time.

automations.noticeTitle: Automation “{name}” was auto-disabled after repeated failures
